items.exampleEn: My sister got a job at a bank last month.
items.exampleZh: 我的姊妹上個月在一家銀行找到工作。

items.exampleEn: The head of our school gave a speech on the first day of school.
items.exampleZh: 我們校長在開學第一天發表了演說。

items.exampleEn: Thanks for giving me a ride after the party.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你在派對結束後載我一程。

items.exampleEn: The game was stopped because of heavy rain.
There is always heavy traffic on this road in the evening.
items.exampleZh: 這條路傍晚總是交通擁擠。

items.exampleEn: I thought the test would be hard. In fact, it was easy.
items.exampleZh: 我以為考試會很難，事實上很簡單。

items.exampleEn: The singer has never talked about her family in public.
items.exampleZh: 這位歌手從來沒有公開談論過她的家人。

items.sentenceEn: Heavy traffic is a big problem in this city.
items.sentenceZh: 交通擁擠是這座城市的一大問題。

items.audioEn: It's raining hard today, so my dad will give me a ride to school.
items.audioZh: 今天雨下得很大，所以我爸爸會載我去學校。
items.questionZh: 說話的人今天怎麼去學校？

items.sentenceEn: She will give a speech at the meeting tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 她明天會在會議上發表演說。

items.sentenceEn: It isn't easy to get a job in this city.
items.sentenceZh: 在這個城市找工作並不容易。

items.stemEn: There was ____ last night, and some roads were closed.
items.stemZh: 昨晚下了大雨，有些道路被封閉了。

items.stemEn: Tom looks shy, but ____ he loves talking to people.
items.stemZh: Tom 看起來很害羞，但事實上他很喜歡跟人聊天。

items.passageEn: Last Friday was a big day for Ken. He had just got a job at a travel company, and he had to give a speech to the whole team. In the morning there was heavy rain, and the roads were full of cars. His neighbor kindly gave him a ride, but the heavy traffic made them late. Ken was nervous about speaking in front of so many people, but in fact his speech went very well. Everyone smiled, and his new boss shook his hand.
items.passageZh: 上週五對 Ken 來說是個大日子。他剛在一家旅行社找到工作，必須對整個團隊發表演說。早上下著大雨，路上滿是車子。他的鄰居好心載他一程，但交通擁擠讓他們遲到了。Ken 對在這麼多人面前說話很緊張，但事實上他的演說非常順利。大家都笑了，他的新老闆還跟他握手。

questions.questionZh: Ken 的鄰居幫了他什麼忙？

items.promptZh: 明天早上我可以載你去機場。
referenceEn: I can give you a ride to the airport tomorrow morning.
Tomorrow morning, I can give you a ride to the airport.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 give you a ride to the airport 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 drive you to the airport、take you to the airport 等）也算對
「明天早上」可寫，例如 tomorrow morning 等，可放句首或句尾
可用 can、will 等（例如 I can give you a ride、I'll drive you 等）

items.promptZh: 我不喜歡在大家面前唱歌。
referenceEn: I don't like singing in public.
I don't like to sing in public.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 in public 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 in front of people、in front of others 等）也算對
like 後面可接動名詞或不定詞（例如 singing、to sing 等）
